propositions: Two CloudWatch alarms (voter_errors and replication_errors) declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, causing OK-to-ALARM transitions to notify nobody despite wired SNS topic subscription.

Eleven of thirteen aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm resources in infra/terraform/ follow the established convention of wiring both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn; these two are the only exceptions.
The alarm headers themselves document intent to surface failures to operators, contradicting their implementation of empty actions; this is a defect, not intended behavior.

A guard test must parse every aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm block and fail on any lacking alarm_actions, with anti-vacuity assertion (>= 13 alarms found) and mandatory documented opt-out marker for intentionally silent alarms.
Merging terraform HCL changes does not apply them to AWS; the alarms remain unconfigured in production until operator runs terraform apply, which must be explicitly tracked and reported.
